message.content: {"note_claim": "The image is edited: the 'Latinos for Trump 2024' text was digitally added to a shirt that had no writing, so it is not an authentic ICE photo of someone wearing that shirt.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "an unknown user doctored the photo with the \"Latinos for Trump 2024\" logo. The same user altered the agents' uniforms to read \"ICE,\" when the original picture showed \"HSI\"", "reason": "The page confirms the photo was doctored to add the logo onto a shirt with no writing, though it dates the original to a 2018 Ohio raid rather than a 2020 Georgia AP photo."}
